tabs.label: histogram: global vs private vs DSMEM

single.sql:
SELECT method, cluster_size, hist_kib, ms
FROM histogram_dsmem
single.transformScript:
# One point per (method, cluster size, histogram size): the median of the runs.
df = df.groupby(['method', 'cluster_size', 'hist_kib'], as_index=False)['ms'].median()
single.layoutScript:
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 7,
}


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)

# (method, cluster size) -> label, colour, marker
LINES = [(("global", 1), "global atomics", "#d62728", "s"),
         (("private", 1), "private copy per block", "#2ca02c", "s"),
         (("dsmem", 2), "DSMEM, cluster of 2", "#9ecae1", "o"),
         (("dsmem", 4), "DSMEM, cluster of 4", "#6baed6", "o"),
         (("dsmem", 8), "DSMEM, cluster of 8", "#3182bd", "o"),
         (("dsmem", 12), "DSMEM, cluster of 12", "#08519c", "o")]


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (16, 6.5))
    time_ax, ratio_ax = fig.subplots(1, 2)
    sizes = sorted(df["hist_kib"].unique())
    glob = df[df["method"] == "global"].set_index("hist_kib")["ms"]
    for (method, cs), label, color, marker in LINES:
        line = df[(df["method"] == method) & (df["cluster_size"] == cs)].sort_values("hist_kib")
        if line.empty:
            continue
        time_ax.plot(line["hist_kib"], line["ms"], color=color, marker=marker, label=label)
        ratio_ax.plot(line["hist_kib"], line["ms"].values / glob.reindex(line["hist_kib"]).values,
                      color=color, marker=marker)
    ratio_ax.axhline(1, color="0.5", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.6)   # as fast as global atomics
    for axis in (time_ax, ratio_ax):
        axis.set_xscale("log", base=2)
        axis.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
        axis.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
        axis.set_xticklabels([str(int(s)) for s in sizes])
        axis.set_xlabel("histogram size (KiB)")
        axis.set_yscale("log")
        axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%g"))
        axis.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(NullFormatter())
        axis.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    time_ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator([0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20]))
    time_ax.set_ylabel("time (ms, median of 11 runs)")
    time_ax.set_title("time to build the histogram")
    ratio_ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator([0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10]))
    ratio_ax.set_ylabel("time / time with global atomics")
    ratio_ax.set_title("compared with global atomics")
    fig.legend(*time_ax.get_legend_handles_labels(), loc="outside upper center", ncol=3, frameon=False)

single.sql:
SELECT block_size, smem_bytes, cluster_size, grid, api_blocks, measured_blocks, max_blocks_per_sm
FROM cluster_residency
single.transformScript: # Nothing to do: one row per case.
single.layoutScript:
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 7,
}


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)

import numpy as np

COLORS = {1: "#7f7f7f", 2: "#9ecae1", 4: "#6baed6", 8: "#3182bd", 12: "#08519c"}


def bars(axis, part, key, label_of):
    """Grouped bars: one group per value of `key`, one bar per cluster size;
    the bar is the measured number of blocks alive at once, the black dot what
    the occupancy API predicted, the label above the most blocks on one SM."""
    groups = sorted(part[key].unique())
    sizes = sorted(part["cluster_size"].unique())
    width = 0.8 / len(sizes)
    for i, cs in enumerate(sizes):
        d = part[part["cluster_size"] == cs].set_index(key).reindex(groups)
        x = np.arange(len(groups)) + (i - (len(sizes) - 1) / 2) * width
        axis.bar(x, d["measured_blocks"], width * 0.92, color=COLORS.get(cs, "0.3"),
                 label="no cluster" if cs == 1 else f"cluster of {cs}")
        axis.plot(x, d["api_blocks"], "o", color="black", markersize=5,
                  label="occupancy API" if i == 0 else None)
        for xi, m, s in zip(x, d["measured_blocks"], d["max_blocks_per_sm"]):
            axis.annotate(f"{m:.0f}\n({s:.0f}/SM)", (xi, m), xytext=(0, 3), textcoords="offset points",
                          ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9, color="0.25")
    axis.set_xticks(range(len(groups)))
    axis.set_xticklabels([label_of(g) for g in groups])
    axis.set_yscale("log")
    axis.yaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator([10, 30, 100, 300, 1000]))
    axis.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%d"))
    axis.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(NullFormatter())
    axis.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
    axis.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=11, loc="upper right")


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (18, 6.5))
    by_block, by_smem = fig.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True)
    bars(by_block, df[df["smem_bytes"] == 0], "block_size", lambda b: f"{b} threads")
    by_block.set_title("block size (no shared memory)")
    by_block.set_ylabel("blocks alive at the same time (GPU)")
    bars(by_smem, df[df["smem_bytes"] > 0], "smem_bytes", lambda s: f"{s // 1024} KiB")
    by_smem.set_title("shared memory per block (128 threads)")
    by_block.set_ylim(10, df["measured_blocks"].max() * 3)   # one range for both panels
    fig.suptitle(f"How many blocks run at once ({df['grid'].iloc[0]} launched)")

SELECT smid, gpc, tpc_pos, median
FROM l2_topology
single.transformScript: # Nothing to do: one row per SM (median of its timed L2 loads).
single.layoutScript:
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 7,
}


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)

import numpy as np


def heatmap(fig, axis, grid, title, cmap):
    """GPCs as rows, TPC positions as columns, the value written in every cell;
    empty cells (a GPC with fewer TPCs) stay blank."""
    image = axis.imshow(np.ma.masked_invalid(grid.values), cmap=cmap, aspect="auto")
    for g in range(grid.shape[0]):
        for p in range(grid.shape[1]):
            v = grid.values[g, p]
            if not np.isnan(v):
                light = v < np.nanmin(grid.values) + 0.55 * (np.nanmax(grid.values) - np.nanmin(grid.values))
                axis.text(p, g, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=14,
                          color="white" if light else "black")
    axis.set_xticks(range(grid.shape[1]))
    axis.set_xticklabels([f"pos {p}" for p in grid.columns])
    axis.set_yticks(range(grid.shape[0]))
    axis.set_yticklabels([f"GPC {g}" for g in grid.index])
    axis.set_xlabel("TPC position inside the GPC")
    axis.set_title(title)
    fig.colorbar(image, ax=axis, label="cycles")


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (17, 0.9 * df["gpc"].nunique() + 3))
    # one cell per TPC: the mean of its two SMs (they read the same)
    grid = df.groupby(["gpc", "tpc_pos"])["median"].mean().unstack("tpc_pos")
    left, right = fig.subplots(1, 2)
    heatmap(fig, left, grid, "L2 load latency (median)", "viridis")
    # minus each GPC's cheapest TPC: the distance of every TPC inside its GPC
    heatmap(fig, right, grid.sub(grid.min(axis=1), axis=0), "minus the GPC's minimum", "magma")
